covenants.notes: Occupancy at Northgate Crossing fell to 87 percent in August 2026 with 25 units held off line for the value-add renovation. Waived by the credit officer on 4 September 2026 for the duration of the renovation programme; see policy exception CRE-OCC-01. evaluations.comments: May 2026 rent roll: Crossing at 91 percent with 14 units off line.
June 2026 rent roll: Crossing at 89 percent as the second renovation phase opened, one point below the test.
July 2026 rent roll: Crossing at 87 percent with 25 units off line. Waived for the duration of the renovation programme on 4 September 2026 under policy exception CRE-OCC-01.

covenants.detail: Cash management trigger: springing lockbox and hard cash management at any property whose quarterly debt service coverage ratio falls below 1.15x, and all operating accounts to be maintained with the bank.
covenants.clause: Section 5.17 of each Loan Agreement and the Deposit Account Control Agreements dated 15 May 2024, 20 September 2024 and 1 November 2024.
covenants.notes: Not sprung. The weakest property at 30 June 2026 is Northgate Crossing at 1.27x, twelve basis points of coverage above the trigger. Compliant here means the trigger has not been hit and cash management remains soft.

evaluations.comments: Q1 2026: weakest property at 1.31x, trigger not sprung.
Q2 2026: weakest property Crossing at 1.27x, trigger not sprung. Monitored monthly while the renovation runs.

reviews.narrative: Annual credit review of the Northgate relationship, prepared ahead of the 28 September 2026 review date. Grade affirmed at 4.
reviews.summary: Northgate group: $54.95MM committed across eight booked facilities in three property packages, $51.983MM outstanding, plus a $9.0MM proposed acquisition mortgage for Highland Court in credit underwriting. 618 units across three Charlotte submarkets, portfolio net operating income $29.0MM. Secured by first deeds of trust with absolute assignments of rents on all three communities, second deeds of trust for the two capex lines and the renovation loan, a first UCC lien on the Crossing solar array, and $1.85MM of lender-held reserves. Guaranteed by the sponsor and by James Whitcombe and Adaeze Nwosu as limited guarantors under carve-out and full-recourse structures.
reviews.recommendation: Affirm the grade at 4 and renew the review cycle. Continue the occupancy waiver at Northgate Crossing until the renovation programme completes and the property re-leases above 90 percent. Approve the Highland Court acquisition mortgage subject to a satisfactory appraisal, a clean Phase I and formation of the single-purpose borrower.
reviews.riskComments: Risk grade affirmed at 4. Portfolio loan to value of 68.4 percent is inside the 70 percent test and property debt service coverage is 1.42x at Ridge, 1.33x at Park Place and 1.27x at Crossing, all above the 1.25x minimum. The single covenant breach is physical occupancy at Crossing, 87 percent against a 90 percent test, caused by 25 units held off line for renovation and waived on 4 September 2026. The cash management trigger at 1.15x has not sprung.
reviews.strengths: Seventeen years of multifamily operating history under the same two principals, with in-house property management. All three communities in supply-constrained Charlotte submarkets with renewal trade-outs running 4.1 percent. $21.7MM of equity above the mortgages on as-is appraised value. Reserves of $1.85MM held by the lender across the portfolio. No maturity inside twenty four months.
reviews.weaknesses: Single-market concentration: all 618 units are in Mecklenburg County, North Carolina. Northgate Crossing carries execution risk on the value-add programme, is the source of the occupancy breach, and at 82 percent of as-is value is the most levered position in the book. Thin post-conversion coverage at Crossing of 1.27x leaves twelve basis points above the cash management trigger. The Highland Court acquisition would add $9.0MM of exposure in the same market.

riskRatingReviews.comments: Annual risk rating review supporting the 2026 annual review. Computed grade 4 on portfolio cash flow coverage of 1.34x, sponsor liquidity of $6.4MM and seventeen years of management experience. No override requested.
